name: move-break-through
about: A wall across the map at x = 10: player 2's Walls in rows 0..9, resources in rows 10..19. With break_through, a melee unit (row 4) walks up to the wall, destroys the Wall in its way (10 ticks, +10 destroy score) and walks through; a builder (row 14) mines its way into the resources. Without break_through (row 7) the unit waits at the reachable cell closest to its target, and takes the breach once it is free of units (pathfinding sees units where they stand at the start of the tick).
random: the order of the attacks (the events list), and the choice among equally short paths
